answer.says: One will do, Ramesh. The cold morning air has sharpened my appetite. Thank you.
answer.thought: Ramesh retreats to the kitchen, and the chai remains in my hand. The warmth of the cup contrasts with the crisp 20-degree air, a small comfort in a day that is already becoming a sequence of administrative frictions. I will drink this slowly, watching the verandah, before I must descend into the study to confront Lindner's letter.
